concept.title: Active sound design
concept.shortdesc: Active sound design generates a virtual engine sound when the accelerator pedal is pressed to enhance driving enjoyment.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleActive Sound Design to adjust the volume of the virtual engine sound or to turn it off.

note.p: If the vehicle’s speakers or amplifier are replaced without authorization, Active sound design may not function properly.
The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
